tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs, above bg; in light they are set apart by border and shadow-2.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table headers and code blocks, on bg.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hovered rows and a selected item's fill.

tokens.name: fg-1
tokens.usage: Body text, titles and icons, on bg and surface-1.

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text and icons beside labels, on bg and surface-1.

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Metadata and captions, on bg and surface-1. The faintest text allowed.

tokens.name: fg-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: fg-on-fill
tokens.usage: Labels inside a pale chart fill, such as chart-seq-1 in light and chart-seq-7 in dark, or a midpoint. On the categorical fills labels are white.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: The 1px line around cards and inputs and between rows.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: A selected or focused container's border.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The primary action, links, the focus ring and the one series a chart is about. Sparingly.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: The fill behind a selected row or a highlight.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text such as links, on bg and surface-1.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success, as a dot or text with a word.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs attention, as a dot or text with a word.

tokens.name: serious
tokens.usage: Serious, between warn and danger: a status dot or badge, always with a word or icon. Never a chart series.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failure and destructive actions, as a dot or text with a word.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and running states.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind an ok badge.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind a warn badge.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind a danger badge.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First categorical series (orange). The six pass `silt design palette` in this order on bg in both themes, and the first three warn at 6.9 for all pairs in both themes, so a scatter plot or map gives its points direct labels or shapes too.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second categorical series (purple).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third categorical series (green).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth categorical series (blue).

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth categorical series (rose).

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Sixth categorical series (teal). Beyond six, fold into Other or use small multiples.

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: Background series when one is emphasised in accent, and the Other bucket.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines and axis lines.

tokens.name: chart-seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential step 1 of 7 (blue), for magnitude: more is darker in light and lighter in dark.

tokens.name: chart-seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential step 2 of 7 (blue), for magnitude: more is darker in light and lighter in dark.

tokens.name: chart-seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential step 3 of 7 (blue), for magnitude: more is darker in light and lighter in dark.

tokens.name: chart-seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential step 4 of 7 (blue), for magnitude: more is darker in light and lighter in dark.

tokens.name: chart-seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential step 5 of 7 (blue), for magnitude: more is darker in light and lighter in dark.

tokens.name: chart-seq-6
tokens.usage: Sequential step 6 of 7 (blue), for magnitude: more is darker in light and lighter in dark.

tokens.name: chart-seq-7
tokens.usage: Sequential step 7 of 7 (blue), for magnitude: more is darker in light and lighter in dark.

tokens.name: chart-div-neg-3
tokens.usage: Diverging, below the midpoint (red), step 3 of 3 from it.

tokens.name: chart-div-neg-2
tokens.usage: Diverging, below the midpoint (red), step 2 of 3 from it.

tokens.name: chart-div-neg-1
tokens.usage: Diverging, below the midpoint (red), step 1 of 3 from it.

tokens.name: chart-div-mid
tokens.usage: A diverging scale's neutral midpoint: reads as nothing, never a hue.

tokens.name: chart-div-pos-1
tokens.usage: Diverging, above the midpoint (blue), step 1 of 3 from it.

tokens.name: chart-div-pos-2
tokens.usage: Diverging, above the midpoint (blue), step 2 of 3 from it.

tokens.name: chart-div-pos-3
tokens.usage: Diverging, above the midpoint (blue), step 3 of 3 from it.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, metadata, table footnotes, in fg-3.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: The first paragraph of a document.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between items in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: A compact card's padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: A card's padding; the phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks in a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Around a page's major parts on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and menus.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars and dots.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: A raised, interactive card.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: chart-texture
tokens.usage: A hatch laid over a chart's fill as background-image where colour can't carry a series alone: print, forced colours, or a pair the palette check warns on. The first such series takes it; never on every fill.

tokens.name: chart-texture-cross
tokens.usage: The same hatch at 135 degrees, for a second textured series.
